title: Fronting & Inversion
goal: Employ emphatic word order fronting and subject-verb inversion to add rhetorical weight to key adjectives and clauses.

items: Put an adjective first and the subject after the verb to stress a quality.
Front a place or time phrase and put the subject after the verb.
Make the verb agree with a plural subject that comes after it.
Use evaluative words such as 'primordial', 'insólito' and 'concluyente' in emphatic sentences.
I can put an adjective first and the subject after the verb to stress a quality.
